benchmarks.label: Have used AI assistants for online shopping
benchmarks.denominator: All respondents to Adobe's March 2026 consumer survey; companion survey of more than 5,000 US respondents
benchmarks.interpretation: Survey-reported use for online shopping; includes assistance short of agent-executed checkout.

benchmarks.label: Say AI improved online shopping experience
benchmarks.denominator: Respondents who reported using AI for online shopping in Adobe's March 2026 consumer survey
benchmarks.interpretation: Self-reported experience among users, not an exmxc sentiment score or an agent purchase rate.

benchmarks.label: Report a tech/software purchase with AI help
benchmarks.denominator: Consumers in Adobe's March 2026 consumer survey; exact category question wording is not published in the summary
benchmarks.interpretation: Self-reported purchase with AI help in tech/software. The source does not establish agent-executed checkout.

benchmarks.label: Growth in AI-sourced visits to US retail sites
benchmarks.denominator: AI-sourced retail visits in Q1 2025; Adobe Analytics retail-site coverage
benchmarks.interpretation: Growth in visits, not share of purchases or completed agent checkouts.

releases.notes: First-party episode and controlled selection lanes have no qualifying evidence in this foundation release. The published Adobe aggregates remain separate from exmxc observations.
